description: Concrete volume and bag calculator — Concrete needed for a slab, footing, wall, round column/sonotube or poured stairs: cubic feet, cubic yards, cubic meters, order quantity with waste, 40/60/80-lb bag counts, 10-yd truckloads, weight and a bagged-vs-ready-mix recommendation. Params: length, width (ft) and thickness (in) for slab/footing; shape=wall with height; shape=column with diameter (in) and height (ft); shape=stairs with steps, width, rise, run (in). Optional: waste (percent, default 10), count (repeat units), unit (ft|in|m|cm|mm applies to all lengths; or suffix values like 6m, 20cm). Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
